description: Controlled 5-task acceptance benchmark testing diverse reasoning capabilities across geometric, topological, repeating, object-relational, and structural domains.
selection_methodology: Selected to represent 5 distinct ARC transformation families: (1) Composition/Fractal, (2) Topological Enclosed Region, (3) Repeating Alternating Tile, (4) Relational Color/Object Invariance, (5) Structural Multi-Region Filling. Includes both expressible primitives and hard search limits to avoid selection bias.

tasks.description: Kronecker expansion where pattern layout dictates placement of pattern copies.
Interior enclosed 0-holes within foreground boundaries filled with a newly introduced color (4).
Alternating 3x3 horizontal tiling with alternating row flips.
Relational color assignment conditioned on foreground component structure.
Multi-region interior filling conditioned on component area and boundary enclosure.

regression_suite.description: Minimal bounding box crop enclosing non-zero foreground content.
Directional downwards gravity shifting all non-zero cells to the floor.
Identifies largest connected component and crops to its bounding box.
